title: 第十三章 炸裂的七星羁绊第十四章 回归磐气
slug: 种魔得仙第两千三十二章开了
content_zh:
;;
山门里，始终没有声音传出山来。
浮罗真人这个老家伙，喊到最后，自己也无趣起来，满目的阴沉嫉恨，十分吓人，比起魔头来，好不到哪里。
而虫姥姥，高墙，浮罗真人三人联手，同样轰不破怒火道宗的守山大阵，无奈收手，只能继续等更多高手来。
终于，山外又一次沉静下来。
赢商开始郁闷，浮罗真人你这么会说，为什么不再多说点呢？剑横秋的天道羁绊值，到底还是没有冲上五星半。
琢磨了片刻，感觉再无杀来的哪个，会挑动他与剑横秋之间的更多羁绊，先让浪三刀，送他回去修炼。
……
时间一天天过去。
陆陆续续，还有赢商的仇家来，全是相气境界里的，联手之后，依然破不开怒火道宗的山门大阵。
这个大阵，已经达到了下一个大境界——元婴的层次，根本不是光靠相气修士，数量的堆积，就破的开的。
而各路修士，来找怒火道宗麻烦的消息，已经开始传了开去，瞧热闹的修士，也来了不少。
山野之中，一片热热闹闹！
……
这一天，北方天空里。
那艘画船一样的精致木舟，终于划空到来，船上修士，正是白衣青年和红衣美妇。
“解战袍？他怎么来了？”
“他和赢商，也有深仇大恨吗？还是来瞧热闹的？”
“解战袍的师傅，是我们沧澜星斗，五大超级高手之一的帝师，赢商若是惹过他，那就真死定了！”
山野之中，一片声音起来。

虫姥姥等人，也是一头雾水，不过这个解战袍的来头太大了，几人还是迎了上去。一番寒暄后，虫姥姥几人，先说了说这一边的情况，随后问起解战袍的来意。
“自然是和诸位一样，赢商这个狗东西，在蓝雾迷城里，抢了我的机缘，我来问他讨个说法的。”
解战袍一脸恶狠狠。
几人点头，心中却还是狐疑，身为帝师的弟子，解战袍哪里还差什么机缘。不过对方不肯多说，他们也没有多问。
“赢商现在，到底是死是活？”
“活着，我察觉到了他的灵识力量，那强弱程度，绝对是他，我不会认错的。”
虫姥姥一脸笃定。
高墙三人，也点了点头。
“好极了，那就破阵，把这个老东西挖出来，苟活的机会，也不给他！”
……
又是一场破阵开启，这一次，由那红衣美妇领衔，熟悉的修士，早已经认出她的身份，怒火道宗的长老吴山黛。
吴山黛在众人的目光里，尤其是解战袍的威凌目光里，咬着牙朝山门大阵飞去，从她答应解战袍的时候，就已经没有退路可走。
而大阵之下，赢商一点不关心吴山黛，他的灵识，看着解战袍。
“奇怪，我和这个家伙，除了在蓝雾迷城里，争了一场，并无其他交集，为何他会来找我的麻烦？而且算起来，也是我替他挡了假铸婴丹的灾。”
旁边的浪三刀的这条大汉，也罕见的神色凝重起来，实在是解战袍的来头太大了！
“宝灵，跟我说说解战袍的事情。”
“是，主人。”
声音再次响起心中。
“解战袍，男性，一百九十八岁，相气中期境界，离后期一步之遥。火修，肉身资质十星窍，与主人你的天道羁绊度七星！”
“什么？”

赢商听的直接炸了。

;;
From the mountain gate, there was still no sound coming out of the mountain.
The old guy, Mr. Baluo, became bored by the end of his shouting. His eyes were filled with gloomy jealousy, which was very scary. He was no better than the devil.
However, Grandma Chong, Gao Qiang, and Zhenren Fuluo joined forces, but they were also unable to defeat the Wrath Dao Sect's mountain guarding formation. They had no choice but to stop and could only continue to wait for more masters to come.
Finally, it became quiet again outside the mountain.
Yingshang began to feel depressed, Mr. Balo, you are so good at talking, why don't you say more? Jian Hengqiu's Heavenly Bond value still did not reach five and a half stars.
After pondering for a moment, he felt that no one who came to kill would stir up more bonds between him and Jian Hengqiu, so he let Lang Sandao send him back to practice first.
…
Time passes day by day.
One after another, Ying Shang's enemies came, all of whom were in the Xiangqi realm. After joining forces, they still couldn't break through the mountain gate formation of the Wrath Dao Sect.
This large formation has reached the next great realm - the level of Nascent Soul. It cannot be broken by just relying on the accumulation of numbers of Xiangqi monks.
And the news that monks from all walks of life are coming to trouble the Wrath Dao Sect has begun to spread, and many monks have come to see the excitement.
There is a lot of excitement in the mountains and fields!
…
On this day, in the northern sky.
The exquisite wooden boat, which looked like a painted boat, finally arrived through the air. The monks on the boat were none other than the young man in white and the beautiful woman in red.
"Take off your shirt? Why is he here?"
"Does he and Ying Shang also have a deep hatred? Or are they just here to watch the fun?"
"The master who took off the shirt is our Canglan Xingdou, one of the five super masters. If Ying Shang offends him, he will be dead!"
There was a sound in the mountains and fields.
Grandma Chong and others were also at a loss, but the background of this undressed man was too great, so they still went up to him. After some pleasantries, Grandma Chong and the others first talked about the situation on this side, and then asked about the purpose of Jie Zhanbao's visit.
"Of course, like you all, this bitch Ying Shang robbed me of my opportunity in the Blue Mist City. I came to ask him for an explanation."
The undressed man had a fierce look on his face.
A few people nodded, but they were still suspicious in their hearts. As a disciple of the Emperor's Master, there was no chance of undressing the robe. However, the other party refused to say more, and they didn't ask any more questions.
"Now, Yingshang, is he dead or alive?"
"While alive, I noticed the power of his spiritual consciousness. The level of strength is definitely his. I won't admit it."
Grandma Chong looked determined.
The three people at Gaoqiang also nodded.
"Great, then break the formation, dig out this old guy, and don't give him a chance to survive!"
…
Another battle started, this time led by the beautiful woman in red. The familiar monk had already recognized her identity, Wu Shandai, the elder of the Wrath Dao Sect.
In the eyes of everyone, especially Wei Ling who was taking off her shirt, Wu Shandai gritted her teeth and flew towards the mountain gate formation. From the moment she agreed to take off her shirt, there was no way out.
But under the big formation, Ying Shang didn't care about Wu Shandai at all. His spiritual consciousness looked at the undressing of the shirt.
"It's strange. Apart from our fight in the Blue Mist City, this guy and I had no other interactions. Why would he come to trouble me? And after all, I was the one who blocked the fake Infant Casting Pill for him."
The big man with Lang San Dao next to him also had a rare expression of solemnity. He really had too much reason to take off his shirt!
"Baoling, tell me about taking off your shirt."
"Yes, Master."
The voice sounded in my heart again.
"Untie the battle robe, male, one hundred and ninety-eight years old, in the middle stage of Xiangqi, one step away from the later stage. Fire cultivator, physical body qualifications and ten star apertures, and the bond of heaven with you, master, to reach seven stars!"
"What?"
Yingshang immediately exploded after hearing this.
